In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: SEBI vs Rajesh Exports
SEBI’s interim order against Rajesh Exports alleges massive financial misrepresentation worth ₹15.45 lakh crore through inflated revenues, questionable accounting practices, and fund transfers involving promoter-linked entities. We will look into how one of India’s biggest gold companies came under regulatory scrutiny and what it means for investors.
Story 2: Can India’s Private Space Companies Make Money?
